This week's theme: The advertising landscape is getting a massive AI rewrite. ChatGPT launches conversion ads, Meta overtakes Google in ad revenue for the first time ever, and Google's core update just decoupled rankings from AI citations. The rules are changing fast.

🚨 Breaking: New Ad Platform

ChatGPT Conversion Ads Are Here

OpenAI is rolling out conversion-optimized ad campaigns. The numbers that matter:

2.5B

Daily prompts processed

$2.5B

Projected 2026 ad revenue

PMM takeaway: A new major ad platform just entered the mix. Start thinking about how conversational intent data differs from search intent — it's more contextual, more specific, and potentially more valuable.

📊 Historic Shift

Meta Dethrones Google in Ad Revenue

For the first time ever, Meta is projected to surpass Google in global advertising revenue:

Meta: $243.5B (+24.1%)
Google: $239.5B (+11.9%)

What it means: Social-first, AI-powered creative is outpacing search. Meta's Advantage+ and AI creative tools are driving efficiency gains that advertisers can't ignore.

🔍 GEO Alert

Google Decouples Rankings from AI Citations

The May 2026 Core Update fundamentally changes the game:

Before: 76% of AI Overview citations came from top-10 ranked pages

After: Only 38% come from top-10 ranked pages

The implication: SEO ≠ AI visibility anymore. Passage structure, quotable claims, and source consistency now matter more than backlinks for getting cited in AI Overviews. This is exactly what our GEO unit covers.

⚡ Quick Hits

This Week in AI + Marketing

💸 $500M Claude bill exposed — A company accidentally racked up a half-billion dollar AI bill in one month. Microsoft cancelled most internal Claude Code licenses as a result. Governance matters.

👥 Salesforce cuts 4K jobs — AI agents now handle 50% of support interactions. Benioff confirms the headcount-for-tokens trade-off is explicit. Meanwhile, they're investing $300M in Anthropic.

🎯 Google "Preferred Sources" — Users can now favorite domains and get 2x click rates in AI Mode. Ask your audience to add your domain — audience loyalty is now a ranking factor.

🤖 CMO musical chairs — ServiceNow's CMO left for OpenAI. Zendesk hired Amplitude's CMO. The enterprise AI marketing talent war is heating up.
